'''Commsat-6''' was a [[communications satellite]] owned and operated by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the years of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It was vitally important to [[Antan Azzameen]], who planned to use the [[Satellite/Legends|satellite]] to spy on the [[Azzameen family]] [[Twin Suns Transport Services/Legends|company's]] rivals [[Viraxo Industries]] and their communications with the Empire. Following an [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] attack on the communications center carried out by an Alliance [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] which [[Ace Azzameen/Legends|Ace Azzameen]] was a part of, the satellite's wiring was damaged; [[Aeron Azzameen]] used this damage to install a listening device at Antan's request.
